testCase.name: [dev] S22 Sign-in code email as delivered: body and TLS hop on a Topflight-owned QA mailbox

descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-02 step 3 · “nothing PHI-bearing exits through an unencrypted channel”. Mixed: stated part — sign-in email body carries no patient data; our part — TLS version of the SES → recipient hop (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S22 Sign-in code email as delivered: body and TLS hop on a Topflight-owned QA mailbox

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. … (UAT OAT-02 step 3; UAT OAT-02; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U2 All traffic is encrypted in transit. This includes the live-dictation audio stream and the backend's calls to the AI and email providers (Bedrock, Vertex, OpenAI, SES). (UAT OAT-02; TFA-92568 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given The deployment Q8 names with SES delivery (TFA-94659 ready for qa), and a Topflight-owned QA mailbox that Daniela approves (Q9). Not on and never with store-review-test-account@roundcompanion.com. …

When Request a sign-in code for the QA mailbox, open the received message's source and read its Received headers.

Then The body matches S14's template: code, expiry and ignore line only, with no name, room, MRN, diagnosis or link. The Received headers show the SES → recipient hop with its TLS version.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-02 step 3 and Expected 'no PHI transmitted via any unencrypted path'. Any patient data or link in the delivered email = Fail. A hop without TLS is recorded and judged per Q9.

Where it ran: dev; test method CONFIG · Config check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
